scope_notes: The full black-box interface is proved only for k = 1.
The unmodified projection convergence is proved for every k > 0.
The actual normalized first compression moment converges almost surely, on one event for all real coefficient vectors.
The actual normalized second compression moment is proved to converge in expectation, not almost surely.
Conditional reduction theorems retain their displayed hypotheses.
remaining_obligations: Higher Haar mixed-moment convergence and identification with the Bernoulli free-sum law.
Sharp upper spectral bounds excluding outliers for general block compressions.
Assembly of FullBlockModifiedStrongInput for every required k and t.
